parameters.name: MemberId
parameters.description: This parameter is scheduled to be offline before 00:00:00 on June 30, 2021. The APIs for its replacement feature, account groups, will be online before 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. If you are using this parameter, we recommend that you switch to the APIs for account groups after 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. For more information about account groups, see [Account groups](~~211534~~).
